'''Sochek''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter and part of a group of Trandoshans that hunted down [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings for sport on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].

==Biography==
[[File:Sochek-WH.png|thumb|left|220px|Sochek holds Ahsoka Tano at gunpoint]]
When the hunting began, Sochek, along with another hunter [[Ratter/Legends|Ratter]], got on a [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|hover pod]], flew into the jungle and searched for their prey. There, they found two prisoners, [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]] and [[Lika/Legends|Lika]], walking in the jungle. Sochek [[Death/Legends|killed]] Lika with his [[Trandoshan blaster/Legends|blaster]] after Ratter killed Katt Mol. Later, the Padawans that were also captured as prey formed a group to stop the Trandoshans. This group consisted of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]].

Sochek was later present alongside [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] and the Trandoshan leader, [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]], near a crashed [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] that had been sabotaged by the Padawans, resulting in the death of [[Clutch/Legends|both]] [[Goron/Legends|pilots]] of the ship and the release of their latest prisoner, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. Sochek and the rest of the Trandoshan crew were present on the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan floating fortress]] when it was attacked by the Padawans and the Wookiee. At first, the Trandoshans managed to outnumber them, but the tide had turned in the Padawans' favor when a group of Wookiee soldiers&mdash;having been contacted earlier by Chewbacca&mdash;arrived. As the fight proceeded, Lo-Taren and Sochek hid behind a hover pod and fired at the Wookiees. However, one of the Wookiees killed Lo-Taren, distracting Sochek to mourn his death. But in the distraction, Jinx used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to raise the hover pod, allowing the same Wookiee to fire at Sochek, killing him too.

==Behind the scenes==
Sochek's name and physical appearance are a reference to Walter Sobchak, a character in the 1998 comedy film ''The Big Lebowski''.<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref>
